behavior_constraints: CSR stores values[], col_indices[], row_ptr[] with row i spanning row_ptr[i]..row_ptr[i+1]-1
COO stores values[], row[], col[] with no ordering requirement and no duplicate (row,col) pairs
CSR-to-COO and COO-to-CSR conversions work in both directions
SpMV computes y = A*x on CSR matrices
Transpose produces a new CSR matrix equal to A^T
Symmetric check uses a tolerance parameter
Diagonal extraction returns a vector of diagonal entries
Matrix Market reader handles '%%MatrixMarket matrix coordinate real' header and symmetric/general qualifiers
Symmetric qualifier causes reader to expand lower-triangular entries to full matrix
Comment lines beginning with % are skipped
entities.summary: Add full sparse matrix support (CSR/COO with conversions and CSR operations), Matrix Market I/O, Krylov iterative solvers (CG, GMRES(m)) with Jacobi/ILU(0)/SSOR preconditioning, and a 2D Poisson finite-difference solver, exposed via new sparse-solve and poisson CLI commands while preserving the existing dense-solve command.

instruction_head:
We need to extend numsim with full sparse matrix support, iterative Krylov solvers with preconditioning, and a 2D Poisson equation solver that exercises all of these together. The current codebase only handles dense systems with direct LU --- that does not scale.

## Sparse Matrix Infrastructure
